auditor_role: Senior ML Research Engineer & IEEE Access Reproducibility Auditor

check_01_live_processes.findings: Completed recovery artifacts were audited from disk; no running process is required for metric reproduction.

check_02_five_fold_cv_completion.findings: The isolated recovery run contains six models, five folds per model, and 13,200 OOF rows (2,200 unique samples per model).

check_03_independent_metric_recalculatio.findings: All 45 ablation prediction CSVs and all six complete CV OOF prediction sets were independently recalculated.

check_04_sample_counts_and_boundaries.findings: OOF sample identities, true labels, fold assignments, fold metrics, and confusion matrices verified against raw data. Legacy ablation sample IDs and historical fit-time preprocessing state are unavailable.

check_05_validated_tables_generated.findings: Generated Table 1 (5-seed ablation), Table 2 (CV results), Table 3 (per-class metrics), Table 4 (calibration), and Confusion Matrices JSON.

check_06_statistical_tests_and_limitatio.findings: Paired t-test and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests documented. Documented no statistical difference (p>0.10) between Full and ablated variants. Documented power limitations for N=5.

check_07_code_audit_leakage_and_architec.findings: Current code fits scalers per training partition; saved historical fit-time state is not independently recoverable. Active prior source derivation is unverified. Historical corrected checkpoint anchoring must not be inferred from current code.

check_08_results_package_and_manifest.findings: Saved validation report, manifest, and reproducible instructions.

check_09_no_mutation_or_fabrication.findings: This generator recomputes results from saved evidence; current code does not manufacture missing measurements.

check_10_critical_issue_reported.findings: The previous incomplete neural-CV run remains preserved. The paper tables use the separately completed recovery run, retain the Decision Tree depth=6 limitation, and show XGBoost—not KG-Hybrid—as the highest pooled-accuracy model.

paper_ready_verdict: The saved experiment package is internally reproducible from complete five-fold OOF evidence. Submission readiness is not established: source derivation, manuscript metrics, and historical knowledge-policy evidence require reconciliation. Submission claims must retain repeated-held-out-test and Decision Tree depth=6 limitations, and must not claim KG-Hybrid outperforms XGBoostBaseline on this CV protocol.

historical_checkpoint_knowledge_policy.note: Current code policy does not retroactively change completed experiments
